name: Finance Block
description: 财务块 Finance Block —— 个人财务 OS：以 fin-beancount 代码块为唯一真源的复式记账，配套流水 / 预算 / 热力图 / 现金流模拟 / 资产总览 / 日常花费与贷款视图。KOS 原生、极致可配置，数据纯文本存 vault、可双链、可进 Git。Personal finance OS: double-entry bookkeeping with fin-beancount code blocks as the single source of truth, plus views for transactions, budgets, heatmaps, cash-flow simulation, assets, and recurring expenses/loans. KOS-native, deeply configurable.
author: wanguliux
